symbols.name: stored bit volume
symbols.meaning: The number of data bits the array holds.
symbols.quote: $V$ is the stored bit volume: the number of data bits the array holds.

symbols.name: field width
symbols.meaning: The number of address bits in one field; the letter changes meaning here from earlier pages.
symbols.quote: $u$ is the width of each field: the number of address bits in one field.

symbols.name: cost exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent with 0<\tau<1 in the cost bound O(V u^\tau).

symbols.name: width reduction factor
symbols.meaning: The fixed integer, at least 2, by which each level divides the field width.
symbols.quote: Each level divides the field width by a fixed integer $c\ge 2$.

symbols.name: wire count
symbols.meaning: The number of wires of the network whose edges carry the shear matrices.
symbols.quote: The network has $W$ wires and total edge rank $s$, the sum of its edge matrix ranks.

symbols.name: total edge rank
symbols.meaning: The sum of the ranks of the edge matrices of the network, which is the number of recursive calls per level.
symbols.quote: The network has $W$ wires and total edge rank $s$, the sum of its edge matrix ranks.

symbols.name: level count
symbols.meaning: The number of recursion levels applied, so that the field width is c^t.

relations.quote: The procedure is applied to each [Address shear](address-shear.md) that a layer produces.
It runs the [Linear network with restored auxiliary values](linear-network-exchange.md), whose gates act on the stored array and restore every auxiliary value.
